label: Anthus_sokokensis
summary: The Sokoke pipit (Anthus sokokensis) is a species of bird in the family Motacillidae. It is found in Kenya and Tanzania. Its natural habitat is subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests.

appearance.colors: It has richly coloured upperparts, prominent pale wingbars, and a heavily streaked breast.
